highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Founded as the Drexel Institute of Art, Science and Industry in 1891, Drexel University is a private research university in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

A unique aspect of the University is its co-op programs–one of the largest and oldest in the US, allowing students to gain up to 18 months of professional work experience during their degree.

Drexel is a top-tier research university, with significant contributions to fields like nanotechnology, robotics, and health sciences. The University is ranked R1 for research under the Carnegie Classification and is also ranked among the top 50 private institutions among national universities by the U.S. News and World Report (2025).

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
With over 300 student clubs and organisations, over 35 fraternities, and a wide variety of visual and performing arts ensembles, you’ll be part of a vibrant and multicultural student population at Drexel.

Not only that, you’ll always have friendly personal support through the University’s Counseling and Health offices. Moreover, the Drexel Student Health Centre provides you with health-related needs. What’s more, the Counseling Centre offers free, confidential counseling services provided by mental health professionals, and also holds workshops and presentations.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Drexel University provides on-campus housing for first-year, transfer, returning, and graduate students. Drexel comprises 9 residence halls and 3 affiliated properties. You can choose from various housing options like shared suites, Living Learning Communities, and Gender-Inclusive Housing.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
Drexel’s libraries are modern, tech-rich spaces. The main library on campus, the W.W. Hagerty Library, offers you various study environments, including quiet study areas, group study rooms, and collaboration spaces. On the other hand, the Hahnemann Library is focused on resources for students in the College of Nursing and Health Professions.

Sports
Drexel University boasts state-of-the-art sports and recreation facilities. The John A. Daskalakis Athletic Centre — also known as the DAC — is the official home of Drexel Athletics. It includes a swimming pool, five squash courts, a golf centre, and a gymnasium.

Drexel has two beach volleyball courts, two tennis courts, and a soccer field. The state-of-the-art Drexel Recreation Centre is an 18,000-square-foot facility with an elevated jogging track, multi-purpose gym, climbing wall, and many more. Drexel also offers personal training, wellness workshops, and fitness challenges to support physical and mental health.

Laboratory
Drexel has high-tech lab facilities for hands-on learning experiences. The Bossone Research Enterprise Centre at the campus is home to many engineering labs. The Drexel College of Medicine Labs includes molecular biology labs, clinical research labs, and simulation labs.

You can also find other labs for Computing and Technology, Virtual Reality, Design and Media Arts, and more.

Cafeteria
Drexel University offers a variety of on-campus dining options. The Drexel Dining Hall is the main dining area offering buffet-style meals. The Daskalakis Athletic Centre Dining is a great spot for athletes or anyone looking for a healthy snack after a workout. Drexel also regularly hosts food trucks offering a variety of cuisines.
